```{r setup, include=FALSE}

  # Load required packages
    if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
      install.packages("pacman")
    }
    # Use pacman to install and loac all packages
      pacman::p_load(readxl, dynamicSDM, rgbif, dplyr, purrr, tidyverse, lubridate,
                     geodata, leaflet, terra, sf, ecospat, biomod2, maxnet,
                     furrr, future, progressr, ohvbd, tidyterra) 
```



```{r Load Data}

  # Load vector data
    VectorData <- readxl::read_xlsx(
      path = "C:/Users/ianpsheasmith/Documents/GitHub/GeorgiaVectors/data/Occurrence_Points/VectorData_w_Dates.xlsx",
      col_types = c(
        "text",      # species
        "date",      # date
        "numeric",   # count
        "text",      # source
        "numeric",   # latitude
        "numeric",   # longitude
        "text",      # month_name
        "text",      # year
        "text"       # popup_text
      )
    )

  # Load Georgia Shapefile
    Georgia_adm2 <- geodata::gadm(
        country = "GE", 
        level = 2, 
        path = "C:/Users/ianpsheasmith/Documents/GitHub/GeorgiaVectors/Shapefiles"
    )
```
